review_candidates.title: Microsoft Center of Excellence Senior Manager
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role combines technical leadership and strategic oversight, ensuring the platform estate meets high engineering standards, scales through reusable patterns and an enabled maker community, and comply with security, data privacy, and responsible AI practices. Key Responsibilities: Platform Strategy & Technical Leadership : Own the Microsoft platform strategy and roadmap across Microsoft 365, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages), and Copilot Studio. Administration
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Job Summary: We are seeking a technically proficient Microsoft Center of Excellence Senior Manager to lead the delivery of enterprise-grade solutions across Microsoft 365, Power Platform, and Copilot. Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into impactful technical solutions. Qualifications: Technical Skills : Strong proficiency in Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Dataverse) and the Power Platform admin center and CoE Starter Kit. Expertise in platform governance: environment strategy, DLP policy, ALM, and CI/CD . Proficiency in identity and security, including Entra ID, conditional access, and role-based access control. Strong proficiency in SharePoint. Experience : 12+ years of professional experience, with 8+ years on Microsoft 365 and Power Platform and technical leadership.
